name: analysis
title: Saved process analysis
for_each: SELECT a.id,s.name FROM analyses a JOIN series s ON s.id=a.series_id ORDER BY a.created_at

sections.title: Saved numerical result
sections.sql: SELECT result->>'n' AS valid_observations,result->>'missing' AS missing_observations,result->>'mean' AS mean,result->>'sample_sd' AS sample_sd,result->>'center' AS center,result->>'lower' AS lower_control_limit,result->>'upper' AS upper_control_limit,result->>'mr_upper' AS moving_range_upper,result->>'pp' AS pp,result->>'ppk' AS ppk,result->>'outside_spec' AS outside_spec,result->>'baseline' AS baseline FROM analyses WHERE id=$1

sections.title: Specification used
sections.sql: SELECT s.revision,s.lower_limit,s.upper_limit,s.reason FROM specifications s JOIN analyses a ON a.specification_id=s.id WHERE a.id=$1

sections.title: Warnings
sections.sql: SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(result->'warnings','[]'::jsonb)) AS warning FROM analyses WHERE id=$1

sections.title: Individuals signals
sections.sql: SELECT x.* FROM analyses a CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(COALESCE(a.result->'signals','[]'::jsonb)) AS x(row integer,measured_at text,value float8,rule text) WHERE a.id=$1

name: investigation
title: Process investigation record
for_each: SELECT id,title FROM actions ORDER BY due

sections.title: Measurement source
sections.sql: SELECT s.name,s.source_name,s.source_sha,s.review_due FROM series s JOIN actions a ON a.series_id=s.id WHERE a.id=$1

sections.title: Recorded notes
sections.sql: SELECT n.body,n.actor,n.created_at FROM notes n JOIN actions a ON a.series_id=n.series_id WHERE a.id=$1 ORDER BY n.created_at
